semantic_novelty: Global absence is supplied by a new host predicate and changes the valid pointer-argument domain, avoiding node lock-offset reads only when every CPU lock is absent. This is distinct from E055 moving three discount loads into a role-local branch, E043 selecting actor-map pointers, E066 caching child offsets, E105 evaluation arity or E104 resident traversal. Those sources are not composed or reopened. Negative literal searches remain bounded, not universal novelty proof.
host_predicate: locks_absent is solver.locks.is_empty at successful construction and immediately after both original update_locks uploads succeed. Any nonempty map, including empty lock vectors, selects original pointer. The dummy sigma buffer remains unchanged and is never used to infer absence.
updates_and_failures: Original sync, table construction, buffer assignments, errors and graph invalidation are retained byte-for-byte. New flag assignment follows both successful GPU uploads and precedes the existing training/evaluation graph reset under exclusive &mut self. Failed sync/upload returns the original error before flag publication; no new GPU work or recovery/fallback is added. Existing update_locks can partially replace buffers on an upload error; no validity of later use after that pre-existing failed update is asserted. Server propagates update_locks error with ? and does not enqueue another iteration.
argument_lifetime: For present locks, E106LockArg delegates exactly to cudarc PushKernelArg<&CudaSlice<i64>>, including original borrowed lifetime and event records. For absence it delegates to the original DeviceRepr argument implementation for a static zero CUdeviceptr, alive through launch/capture. CUDA receives a normal8byte pointer parameter; null is never dereferenced. Existing d_lock_off allocation/owner persists and no raw device pointer is cached. All other arguments delegate untouched.
caller_inventory: Four production bindings: paired_sweep down_action/up_action and evaluation down_action/up_action_eval. Profiled and ordinary graph/eager paths use these same methods. Direct old unit launch retains original nonnull binding, supported by shader fallback. Symmetric/paged/stored continuation constructors require unlocked hosts and only swap seven learning buffers; no continuation writes to the lock buffers or predicate.
required_before_numerical: Actual full host compilation/layout/role check, unchanged6entry PTX/resources and exact modified18/20/17ABIs, original launch/defaultresource gates, semantic conservative CFG proof of zero reachable lock-offset loads with null argument and retained original reads with nonnull argument. Resource pass alone does not admit application kernels. All original raw/FP/graph/lock/unlock/resume/capacity/material/performance gates remain.
